function.name: run_extraction_chain
function.description: Run the full DIA spectrum evidence extraction chain. Produces per-peptide A4 evidence PDFs with isoPSV-style layout (ion ladder, observed spectrum, inverted AlphaPeptDeep prediction, ppm panel, RT heatmap) from DIA raw files and search results.

search_results.description: Path to DIA search results (Spectronaut report or S14-style table with seq/charge/mz/sample/RT)

protein_fasta.description: Path to protein FASTA for flanking residue annotation

output_dir.description: Output directory for evidence PDFs and extraction results

table1_xlsx.description: Optional: manuscript Table 1 xlsx for cross-reference PDF

function.name: audit_evidence
function.description: Run the three-layer automated audit on evidence PDFs: A=data reconciliation (S14→targets→extraction→info fields→cosine→heatmap), B=Table1 crossref (page order, headers), C=presentation (text, heatmap, overflow).

evidence_pdf.description: Path to the main evidence PDF

table1_pdf.description: Path to the Table 1 cross-reference PDF

function.name: predict_missing_spectra
function.description: Run AlphaPeptDeep on-the-fly for peptides that lack theoretical spectrum predictions in the existing pkl.

input_tsv.description: Path to isoPSV input table (identifies peptides with empty PredB column)

prediction_pkl.description: Path to AlphaPeptDeep prediction pkl to update
